name: LANDR
tagline: LANDR provides AI-powered instant music mastering that analyses your track and applies professional-grade processing to prepare it for streaming platforms. Beyond mastering, it offers sample packs, plugin subscriptions, and direct distribution to Spotify, Apple Music, and 150+ platforms. Trusted by over 3 million musicians.
